_comment: Camp rules (design section 10). One camp per character, Wilds only, not within minHubDistance of a hub. Everything else must be within campRadius of your campfire. grid = snap size in metres; rotation snaps to 90 degrees. A camp whose owner has been offline for burnOfflineHours burns down. Structures can only be damaged by the other side, and only during a raid window (UTC hours, every day) until crews set their own (Phase 11). earthBonus multiplies Earth bending damage to structures.
